title: MustBeCleaner Adapter (data-only)
description: R8.1 declarative Adapter. R8.2: no executable content. additionalProperties is false everywhere so unknown or execution-implying fields (script, command, powershell, javascript, ...) are rejected. AdapterLoader enforces the same rules plus the executable-value and path checks that JSON Schema cannot express.

ruleId.description: Stable rule ID, recorded with every classification (R5.6).

sourceReference.description: Where the rule comes from, e.g. a doc path or evidence file. Never a script.

versions.description: Exact app versions this rule was written for. A mismatch means Review (R8.13).

allowedRelativePaths.description: Paths relative to the app root. No drive, UNC, '..' or ':'. A whole segment may be '*'; partial wildcards are rejected. May be empty for inventory-only Adapters.

trust.description: inventory-only until the rule is validated (R8.3).

blockers.description: Condition identifiers that block action, e.g. owner-process-active.

processes.description: Process image names that are matched to decide idleness. They are never launched.
